# Forged Grappling

> A dedicated no-gi grappling gym in Westbury, Wiltshire, UK. Coached classes run
> Monday to Friday, 6–7pm, with open mat 7–8pm. All levels train together and the
> first session is free. Adults 16+.

Forged Grappling teaches no-gi submission grappling: takedowns, positional control,
chokes and joint locks, with no striking and no gi (kimono). It is the only gym in
Westbury dedicated solely to no-gi grappling.

**Location:** Unit 21, Woodlands Industrial Estate, Eden Vale Road, Westbury,
Wiltshire, BA13 3QS, United Kingdom.
**Contact:** info@forgedgrappling.co.uk · +44 7463 580506
**Opening hours:** Monday to Friday, 18:00–20:00. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
**Serves:** Westbury, Trowbridge, Warminster, Frome, Bradford on Avon and the
wider Wiltshire area.

## Classes

- **No-Gi Grappling** — Monday to Friday, 6:00–7:00pm. Coached class, all levels.
  Structure: warm-up games and dynamic drills, then technique, then positional sparring.
- **Structured Open Mat** — Monday to Thursday, 7:00–8:00pm. Supervised mat time
  with coaches available.
- **Community Open Mat** — Friday, 7:00–8:00pm. Free and open to everyone,
  including non-members and visitors from other clubs.

## Pricing

- **Unlimited Membership** — £80/month, or £800/year paid annually (£66.67/month
  equivalent). Every class and open mat, five nights a week.
- **Lite Membership** — £50/month. One class plus the following open mat, once a week.
- **Visitor Pass** — £15/day. A full evening on the mats.
- **Free trial** — the first session is free for first-time visitors.

No contracts on any membership. Monthly memberships can be cancelled any time after
the first 30 days. All memberships carry a 30-day money-back guarantee.

## Coaches

Mitch Cullum, Jack Whitburn, Nathan Cullum and Harry Whitburn. Between them they
cover competition experience, guard and passing, leg locks and catch wrestling, and
teaching complete beginners.
